description: Search the paid x402 APIs listed on x402Fi (Robinhood Chain, priced per call in USDG). Every word of the query must match. Returns endpoints with their price, method and payee name; use get_listing for how to call one.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. 'stock risk' or 'rug check'. Omit to list everything.
